text: Specialized Bicycle Components is a private US company headquartered in Morgan Hill, California, founded and long led by Mike Sinyard. Merida, the Taiwan-based bicycle manufacturer, acquired a minority share of Specialized in 2001; the percentage was not revealed.
short: Specialized is a private US company; Taiwan's Merida holds an undisclosed minority share (2001).
